svg.desc: ghosttea's three-leaf mark drawn as a construction: the three leaf tips sit on one circle around the stem, and each leaf is labelled with a surface: macOS with WebGPU, Windows with WebGPU, iOS with Metal. Underneath: one core, libghostty-vt.
